```{r}
library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2); library(patchwork)
library(knitr); library(scales)   # ncdf4 is only needed to rebuild the summaries (helpers use ncdf4::)
source("../R/alum_scenario_helpers.R")

theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
            theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.background = element_blank()))

# Analysis window: the first two years of each run are spin-up (alum pools
# start at zero, so they are *not* in equilibrium before dosing history builds up).
WIN_START <- as.Date("2013-07-01")
WIN_STOP  <- as.Date("2021-06-30")
N_YR      <- as.numeric(WIN_STOP - WIN_START + 1) / 365.25
K_BUR     <- 0.01      # d-1, aed_alum burial rate in these runs (aed.nml default)
rm30 <- \(x) as.numeric(stats::filter(x, rep(1/30, 30), sides = 2))   # 30-day running mean

tags_all <- c("S0", "S1", "W_0.3", "W_1.0", "W_1.5", "W_5",
              "R_1.4", "R_0.5", "R_0.3", "R_0.15",
              "RES_0.001", "RES_0.01", "RES_0.1", "SURF")
tags <- tags_all[file.exists(file.path(alum_run_dir(tags_all), "output", "output.nc"))]
labels <- c(S0 = "S0 no alum", S1 = "S1 historical dose",
            `W_0.3` = "w_ala 0.3", `W_1.0` = "w_ala 1", `W_1.5` = "w_ala 1.5",
            W_5 = "w_ala 5",
            `R_1.4` = "capacity x1.43 (Al:P 0.7:1)", `R_0.5` = "capacity x0.5",
            `R_0.3` = "capacity x0.3", `R_0.15` = "capacity x0.14 (Al:P 7:1)",
            `RES_0.001` = "resusp k_res 0.001", `RES_0.01` = "resusp k_res 0.01",
            `RES_0.1` = "resusp k_res 0.1", SURF = "surface dose 0.1 mmol/m2/d")

runs <- lapply(setNames(tags, tags), read_alum_run)
lake <- bind_rows(lapply(runs, `[[`, "lake")) |>
  mutate(scenario = factor(scenario, tags, labels[tags]))
zone <- bind_rows(lapply(runs, `[[`, "zone")) |>
  mutate(scenario = factor(scenario, tags, labels[tags]))
lw <- lake |> filter(Date >= WIN_START, Date <= WIN_STOP)   # analysis window

lab <- function(t) factor(labels[[t]], labels[tags])
S0 <- "S0 no alum"; S1 <- "S1 historical dose"
pal <- c("S0 no alum" = "grey35", "S1 historical dose" = "#d95f02")
```


## Purpose and set-up

This page summarises the full GLM-AED output (`output.nc`) of the alum
scenarios run by `scripts/alum/01_run_scenarios.R` with the calibrated
stage 1–3 parameters (`calibration/checkpoints/final/`), the real
inflow/meteorological forcing and the reconstructed alum dosing history
(Puarenga and Utuhina dosing, converted to an inflow `ALU_ala` concentration
by `calc_alum_inflow()`). It follows the diagnostics used in the
[`aed_alum` stress tests](glm-aed-alum-stress-tests.qmd), but applied to the
lake rather than to idealised boxes.

| Scenario | What changes |
|---|---|
| S0 | no alum (`ALU_ala` = 0 in all inflows) |
| S1 | historical dosing, default alum parameters (`w_ala` = 0.5 m/d, 1 mol P capacity per mol Al) |
| `w_ala` 0.3, 1, 1.5, 5 | floc settling velocity: thesis central value 0.5 m/d, plausible range 0.3–1.5, 5 as a weakly-mixed upper bound |
| capacity x1.43 … x0.14 | P-binding capacity per Al scaled onto the dosed inflows: 1.43 = jar test (Al:P 0.7:1), 0.14 = operational field value (~7:1) |
| resuspension | `simResuspension` on (thesis recommendation) with `k_res` 0.001, 0.01, 0.1 d⁻¹ |
| surface dose | no inflow dosing; whole-lake `S_ala` = 0.10 mmol P/m²/d (the thesis' mean-rate equivalent) |

The settling velocities of 20–100 m/d in the thesis are for individually tracked large
flocs (1–3 mm) in still water. The thesis explicitly treats them as upper bounds, because
wind mixing keeps flocs suspended longer, and recommends 0.5 m/d (0.3–1.5) for the model.
An earlier version of this page swept `w_ala` up to 100 m/d, which is outside that
recommendation; it has been replaced by the thesis-based set above.

: Scenarios {.striped}


```{r}
cat("Scenarios found:", paste(tags, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```


::: {.callout-note}
**Interpret differences, not absolute values.** The staged calibration fits
lake P poorly (stage 3 FRP KGE < 0, positive FRP/TP bias), and the TP series
is still rising through the first years of each run. Everything below is
therefore expressed as *alum minus no-alum* (S1 − S0) wherever possible.
:::

Units: concentrations are mmol P/m³ (1 mmol P/m³ = 31 µg P/L); masses are kg P;
benthic pools are summed over the four sediment zones.

## 1. Inflow loading

### 1.1 P and Al loads by stream


```{r}
il <- read_alum_inflow_loads("S1", start = WIN_START, stop = WIN_STOP) |>
  mutate(wy = as.integer(format(Date + 184, "%Y")))   # water year ending 30 June

load_tab <- il |>
  group_by(stream) |>
  summarise(`Flow (Mm3/yr)` = sum(flow_m3d) / 1e6 / N_YR,
            `FRP (t P/yr)`  = sum(frp_kgd) / 1e3 / N_YR,
            `TP (t P/yr)`   = sum(tp_kgd) / 1e3 / N_YR,
            `Alum Al (t/yr)` = sum(al_kgd) / 1e3 / N_YR,
            .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(`TP (t P/yr)`))
tot <- load_tab |> summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum)) |> mutate(stream = "Total")
kable(bind_rows(load_tab, tot), digits = 1,
      caption = "Mean annual external loads over the analysis window (S1 inflow files).")
```


```{r}
#| label: fig-loads
#| fig-cap: "Annual external P load and alum (as Al) dosed, by water year."
ann <- il |> group_by(wy) |>
  summarise(TP = sum(tp_kgd) / 1e3, FRP = sum(frp_kgd) / 1e3,
            Al = sum(al_kgd) / 1e3, .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_longer(-wy)
ggplot(ann, aes(wy, value, fill = name)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = NULL,
                    labels = c(Al = "Al dosed (t Al)", FRP = "FRP load (t P)",
                               TP = "TP load (t P)")) +
  labs(x = "Water year (ending 30 June)", y = "tonnes / yr")
```


```{r}
#| label: fig-dosestream
#| fig-cap: "Daily alum dose (kg Al/d) entering each dosed stream, and the resulting in-stream ALU_ala concentration."
d <- il |> filter(stream %in% c("Puarenga", "Utuhina"))
conc <- d |> mutate(conc = ifelse(flow_m3d > 0, ala_kgd / MMOL_TO_KG / flow_m3d, NA))
p1 <- ggplot(d, aes(Date, al_kgd, colour = stream)) + geom_line(linewidth = .3) +
  labs(y = "kg Al / d", colour = NULL)
p2 <- ggplot(filter(conc, conc > 0), aes(Date, conc, colour = stream)) +
  geom_point(size = .4) + scale_y_log10() +
  labs(y = "ALU_ala (mmol P-capacity / m3)", colour = NULL)
p1 / p2
```


### 1.2 How much P-binding capacity is added relative to the P load?


```{r}
cap <- il |> summarise(
  Al_t = sum(al_kgd) / 1e3, cap_tP = sum(ala_kgd) / 1e3,
  TP_t = sum(tp_kgd) / 1e3, FRP_t = sum(frp_kgd) / 1e3)
kable(tibble(
  Quantity = c("Al dosed (t, window)", "P-binding capacity dosed (t P, 1 Al : 1 P)",
               "External TP load, all streams (t P)", "External FRP load, all streams (t P)",
               "Capacity / TP load", "Capacity / FRP load"),
  Value = c(cap$Al_t, cap$cap_tP, cap$TP_t, cap$FRP_t,
            cap$cap_tP / cap$TP_t, cap$cap_tP / cap$FRP_t)), digits = 2)
```


The nominal capacity added is a large multiple of the FRP actually delivered.
Alum is dosed in streams that carry only part of the P load, so most capacity
is expected to remain unused or be aged away (§5).

## 2. In-lake concentrations


```{r}
#| label: fig-conc
#| fig-cap: "Volume-weighted mean (top) and bottom-layer (lower) concentrations, S0 vs S1."
sel <- lake |> filter(scenario %in% c(S0, S1), Date >= WIN_START)
f <- function(y, ttl, ylab) ggplot(sel, aes(Date, .data[[y]], colour = scenario)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = .35) + scale_colour_manual(values = pal, name = NULL) +
  labs(title = ttl, y = ylab, x = NULL)
(f("frp_mean", "FRP, lake mean", "mmol P/m3") + f("frp_bot", "FRP, bottom layer", "mmol P/m3")) /
(f("tp_mean", "TP, lake mean", "mmol P/m3") + f("chl_mean", "Chlorophyll-a, lake mean", "ug/L")) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```


```{r}
#| label: fig-diff
#| fig-cap: "Alum effect (S1 − S0) on lake-mean FRP, TP and chl-a, 30-day running mean."
rm30 <- \(x) as.numeric(stats::filter(x, rep(1/30, 30), sides = 2))
dd <- lw |> filter(scenario %in% c(S0, S1)) |>
  select(Date, scenario, frp_mean, tp_mean, chl_mean, frp_bot) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(Date, scenario)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = scenario, values_from = value) |>
  mutate(diff = .data[[S1]] - .data[[S0]]) |>
  group_by(name) |> mutate(diff30 = rm30(diff)) |> ungroup()
ggplot(dd, aes(Date, diff30)) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_line(colour = "#d95f02") +
  facet_wrap(~name, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1,
             labeller = as_labeller(c(frp_mean = "FRP lake mean (mmol/m3)",
                                      frp_bot = "FRP bottom (mmol/m3)",
                                      tp_mean = "TP lake mean (mmol/m3)",
                                      chl_mean = "Chl-a lake mean (ug/L)"))) +
  labs(y = "S1 − S0", x = NULL)
```


```{r}
tab <- lw |> group_by(scenario) |>
  summarise(FRP = mean(frp_mean) * 31, `FRP bottom` = mean(frp_bot) * 31,
            TP = mean(tp_mean) * 31, `Chl-a` = mean(chl_mean), .groups = "drop")
b <- tab |> filter(scenario == S0)
tab_out <- tab |>
  mutate(`dFRP %` = 100 * (FRP / b$FRP - 1), `dTP %` = 100 * (TP / b$TP - 1),
         `dChl %` = 100 * (`Chl-a` / b$`Chl-a` - 1))
kable(tab_out, digits = 1,
      caption = "Window-mean concentrations (ug P/L; chl-a ug/L) and change vs S0.")
```


### 2.1 Comparison with observations

Observations are the buoy/CTD/survey data held in the Aeme object (`observations()$lake`),
averaged by day over the epilimnion (0–5 m) or hypolimnion (15–21 m; the model lake is
21 m deep). The model is sampled over the same depth bands (volume-weighted).
The real lake **was** dosed, so S1 is the scenario to compare with the data; S0 shows how
far the no-alum counterfactual departs from what was measured.


```{r}
#| label: fig-obs
#| fig-cap: "Model (S0, S1) against observations (points) in the epilimnion (FRP, TP, chl-a) and hypolimnion (FRP, TP, oxygen), analysis window."
#| fig-height: 8
obs <- read_alum_obs() |> filter(Date >= WIN_START, Date <= WIN_STOP)
vmap <- tribble(
  ~var_aeme,   ~band, ~col,       ~scale, ~panel,
  "PHS_frp",   "epi", "frp_epi",  31,     "FRP, epilimnion (ug P/L)",
  "PHS_frp",   "hyp", "frp_hyp",  31,     "FRP, hypolimnion (ug P/L)",
  "PHS_tp",    "epi", "tp_epi",   31,     "TP, epilimnion (ug P/L)",
  "PHS_tp",    "hyp", "tp_hyp",   31,     "TP, hypolimnion (ug P/L)",
  "PHY_tchla", "epi", "chl_epi",  1,      "Chl-a, epilimnion (ug/L)",
  "CHM_oxy",   "hyp", "oxy_hyp",  1,      "Oxygen, hypolimnion (mg/L)")
mod_long <- lw |> filter(scenario %in% c(S0, S1)) |>
  select(Date, scenario, all_of(vmap$col)) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(Date, scenario), names_to = "col") |>
  left_join(vmap, by = "col") |> mutate(value = value * scale)
obs_long <- obs |> inner_join(vmap, by = c("var_aeme", "band"))
ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = mod_long, aes(Date, value, colour = scenario), linewidth = .35) +
  geom_point(data = obs_long, aes(Date, obs), size = .8, alpha = .6, colour = "black") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal, name = NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~panel, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
```


```{r}
# Model sampled on the observation date; bias = model - obs
ev <- bind_rows(lapply(split(vmap, seq_len(nrow(vmap))), \(m) {
  o <- obs |> filter(var_aeme == m$var_aeme, band == m$band)
  lake |> filter(Date %in% o$Date) |>
    transmute(Date, scenario, model = .data[[m$col]] * m$scale) |>
    inner_join(select(o, Date, obs), by = "Date") |> mutate(panel = m$panel)
})) |> filter(!is.na(model), !is.na(obs))
met <- ev |> group_by(panel, scenario) |>
  summarise(n = n(), `obs mean` = mean(obs), `model mean` = mean(model),
            bias = mean(model - obs), RMSE = sqrt(mean((model - obs)^2)),
            r = suppressWarnings(cor(model, obs)), .groups = "drop")
kable(met |> filter(scenario %in% c(S0, S1)), digits = 2,
      caption = "Model vs observations (S0 and S1) on observation dates, analysis window.")
```


```{r}
tab_obs <- ev |>
  filter(panel %in% c("TP, epilimnion (ug P/L)", "FRP, epilimnion (ug P/L)", "Chl-a, epilimnion (ug/L)")) |>
  group_by(panel, scenario) |>
  summarise(bias = mean(model - obs), RMSE = sqrt(mean((model - obs)^2)), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = panel, values_from = c(bias, RMSE))
kable(tab_obs, digits = 1, caption = "Epilimnion bias / RMSE against observations for every scenario.")
```



## 3. Benthic processes

### 3.1 Settled alum pools


```{r}
#| label: fig-benthic-pools
#| fig-cap: "Settled alum capacity (ALU_ben_ala) and alum-bound P (ALU_ben_alp), summed over zones (left) and per unit area by zone (right), S1."
b1 <- lake |> filter(scenario == S1, Date >= WIN_START) |>
  select(Date, ben_ala_kg, ben_alp_kg) |> pivot_longer(-Date)
pa <- ggplot(b1, aes(Date, value, colour = name)) + geom_line() +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = NULL,
    labels = c(ben_ala_kg = "settled capacity", ben_alp_kg = "settled alum-bound P")) +
  labs(y = "kg P", x = NULL)
z1 <- zone |> filter(scenario == S1, Date >= WIN_START, is.finite(area_m2))
pb <- ggplot(z1, aes(Date, ben_alp, colour = factor(zone))) + geom_line(linewidth = .35) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(name = "Sediment zone\n(1 = deepest)") +
  labs(y = "ALU_ben_alp (mmol P / m2)", x = NULL)
pa + pb
```


```{r}
zt <- zone |> filter(scenario == S1, Date >= WIN_START, is.finite(area_m2)) |>
  group_by(zone) |>
  summarise(`Area (km2)` = mean(area_m2) / 1e6,
            `Bound P, end (mmol/m2)` = last(ben_alp),
            `Bound P, end (t P)` = last(ben_alp) * last(area_m2) * MMOL_TO_KG / 1e3,
            `Benthic uptake (kg P/yr)` = sum(uptake_s * area_m2) * MMOL_TO_KG / N_YR,
            `Sediment FRP flux (mmol/m2/d)` = mean(fsed_frp), .groups = "drop")
kable(zt, digits = 3, caption = "Per-zone benthic alum summary, S1.")
```


### 3.2 Benthic uptake and sediment P release


```{r}
#| label: fig-benthic-fluxes
#| fig-cap: "Lake-integrated benthic fluxes (kg P/d): FRP uptake by settled alum, the potential sediment FRP flux (SDF_Fsed_frp, the input rate), the realised FRP exchange across the sediment-water interface (PHS_frp_dsf, after oxygen limitation) and the adsorbed-P exchange at the SWI. S0 vs S1."
#| fig-height: 6
bf <- lake |> filter(scenario %in% c(S0, S1), Date >= WIN_START) |>
  select(Date, scenario, uptake_s_kgd, fsed_frp_kgd, ads_swi_kgd, dsf_frp_kgd) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(Date, scenario))
ggplot(bf, aes(Date, value, colour = scenario)) + geom_line(linewidth = .3) +
  facet_wrap(~name, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1,
    labeller = as_labeller(c(uptake_s_kgd = "Benthic alum FRP uptake (ALU_uptake_s)",
      fsed_frp_kgd = "Potential sediment FRP flux (SDF_Fsed_frp, input rate)",
      ads_swi_kgd = "Adsorbed-P net flux at SWI (PHS_frp_ads_swi)",
      dsf_frp_kgd = "Realised sediment-water FRP exchange (PHS_frp_dsf)"))) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal, name = NULL) + labs(y = "kg P / d", x = NULL)
```


```{r}
#| label: fig-benthic-seasonal
#| fig-cap: "Mean seasonal cycle of benthic alum uptake and bottom-water FRP, S1 vs S0."
sea <- lw |> filter(scenario %in% c(S0, S1)) |>
  mutate(month = as.integer(format(Date, "%m"))) |>
  group_by(scenario, month) |>
  summarise(uptake_s = mean(uptake_s_kgd), frp_bot = mean(frp_bot) * 31,
            fsed = mean(fsed_frp_kgd), .groups = "drop")
(ggplot(sea, aes(month, uptake_s, colour = scenario)) + geom_line() +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12) + scale_colour_manual(values = pal, name = NULL) +
    labs(y = "Benthic uptake (kg P/d)", x = "Month")) +
(ggplot(sea, aes(month, frp_bot, colour = scenario)) + geom_line() +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12) + scale_colour_manual(values = pal, name = NULL) +
    labs(y = "Bottom FRP (ug P/L)", x = "Month")) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```


### 3.3 Internal FRP release and bottom-water oxygen

The sediment FRP input flux (`fsed_frp`, 0.003–0.010 mmol P/m²/d by zone) is not applied
as-is: AED scales it by an oxygen half-saturation term, so the **realised** exchange
`PHS_frp_dsf` is only a fraction of the **potential** `SDF_Fsed_frp` whenever the bottom water
is oxygenated. Internal loading therefore depends on whether the bottom water goes anoxic.


```{r}
ox <- lw |> filter(scenario == S1) |>
  mutate(Year = as.integer(format(Date + 184, "%Y"))) |>     # water year ending 30 June
  group_by(`Water year` = Year) |>
  summarise(`Min bottom O2 (mg/L)` = min(oxy_bot),
            `Min hypolimnion O2 (mg/L)` = min(oxy_hyp),
            `Days bottom O2 < 2 mg/L` = sum(oxy_bot < 2),
            `Days bottom O2 < 1 mg/L` = sum(oxy_bot < 1),
            `Max anoxic volume (%)` = 100 * max(anox_vol),
            `Max hypoxic volume (%)` = 100 * max(hypox_vol),
            `Potential FRP flux (t P)` = sum(fsed_frp_kgd) / 1e3,
            `Realised FRP release (t P)` = sum(dsf_frp_kgd) / 1e3, .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(`Realised / potential (%)` = 100 * `Realised FRP release (t P)` / `Potential FRP flux (t P)`)
kable(ox, digits = 2, caption = "S1: bottom-water oxygen and internal FRP release by water year (first and last years are partial).")
```


```{r}
raw_o <- read_alum_obs_raw() |>
  filter(Date >= WIN_START, Date <= WIN_STOP)
s1o <- lw$oxy_bot[lw$scenario == S1]
cat(sprintf("Observed O2 at 15-21 m in the window: %d values, min %.2f mg/L; %d < 2 mg/L, %d < 1 mg/L.\n",
            nrow(raw_o), min(raw_o$value), sum(raw_o$value < 2), sum(raw_o$value < 1)))
```


```{r}

#| fig-cap: "Bottom-layer oxygen in S1 (line) against all observed oxygen at 15–21 m (points); dashed lines at 2 and 1 mg/L."
#| fig-height: 4
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = raw_o, aes(as.Date(Date), value), size = .5, alpha = .35, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_line(data = filter(lw, scenario == S1), aes(Date, oxy_bot), colour = "#d95f02", linewidth = .4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(1, 2), linetype = 2) +
  labs(y = "Dissolved oxygen (mg/L)", x = NULL)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-internal
#| fig-cap: "S1: potential sediment FRP flux vs realised release (kg P/d, left) and realised release against bottom-water oxygen (right)."
#| fig-height: 4.5
s1 <- filter(lw, scenario == S1)
pI <- s1 |> select(Date, potential = fsed_frp_kgd, realised = dsf_frp_kgd) |>

  ggplot(aes(Date, value, colour = name)) + geom_line(linewidth = .35) + scale_y_log10() +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = NULL) + labs(y = "kg P / d (log scale)", x = NULL)
pJ <- ggplot(s1, aes(oxy_bot, dsf_frp_kgd, colour = temp_bot)) + geom_point(size = .6) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(name = "Bottom T (°C)") +
  labs(x = "Bottom-layer oxygen (mg/L)", y = "Realised release (kg P/d)")
pI + pJ
```

```{r}
ie <- il |> summarise(ext_frp_t = sum(frp_kgd) / 1e3 / N_YR, ext_tp_t = sum(tp_kgd) / 1e3 / N_YR)
ir <- lw |> filter(scenario == S1) |>
  summarise(rel_t = sum(dsf_frp_kgd) / 1e3 / N_YR, pot_t = sum(fsed_frp_kgd) / 1e3 / N_YR)
kable(tibble(
  Quantity = c("Potential sediment FRP flux (t P/yr)", "Realised internal FRP release (t P/yr)",
               "External FRP load (t P/yr)", "External TP load (t P/yr)",
               "Realised internal / external FRP (%)", "Realised internal / external TP (%)"),
  Value = c(ir$pot_t, ir$rel_t, ie$ext_frp_t, ie$ext_tp_t,
            100 * ir$rel_t / ie$ext_frp_t, 100 * ir$rel_t / ie$ext_tp_t)), digits = 2,
  caption = "Internal vs external P loading, S1.")
```


::: {.callout-warning}
If the model never reaches anoxia while the observations do (compare the counts above), the
realised internal release is a **lower bound**: the oxygen limitation is under-applied in the
model, and any alum effect on internal loading cannot be tested. Check the hypolimnetic oxygen
demand (stage-3 `fsed_oxy`, stratification) before calibrating alum against bottom-water FRP.
:::

## 4. Settling of floc: water column vs benthos


```{r}
#| label: fig-settle
#| fig-cap: "Water-column vs benthic FRP uptake by alum (kg P/d, 30-day mean), S1."
u <- lake |> filter(scenario == S1, Date >= WIN_START) |>
  transmute(Date, `water column` = rm30(uptake_w_kgd), `settled alum (benthic)` = rm30(uptake_s_kgd)) |>
  pivot_longer(-Date)
ggplot(u, aes(Date, value, colour = name)) + geom_line() +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = NULL) + labs(y = "kg P / d", x = NULL)
```


## 5. How much P does alum remove?

For each scenario we integrate, over the analysis window:

* **Capacity dosed** – ALU_ala delivered by the dosed inflows (kg P-equivalent).
* **P bound** – FRP taken up by suspended alum (`ALU_uptake_w` × layer volume)
  plus FRP taken up by settled alum (`ALU_uptake_s` × zone area). These are
  direct model fluxes.
* **Where the bound P goes** – GLM does not output the floc settling or burial
  fluxes, so they are inferred by mass closure from the pools:
    * *exported*: outflow volume × surface-layer ALU_alp;
    * *settled to bed* = water-column uptake − exported − Δ(suspended ALU_alp);
    * *buried* = settled to bed + benthic uptake − Δ(ALU_ben_alp).
* As an independent check the burial implied by `k_bur` × ALU_ben_alp is also
  integrated; the ratio to the closure-implied burial should be ≈ 1.


```{r}
cap_by <- function(tag) {
  il <- read_alum_inflow_loads(tag, start = WIN_START, stop = WIN_STOP)
  cap <- sum(il$ala_kgd)
  if (tag == "SURF") {                       # S_ala (mmol P/m2/d) x surface area x days
    d <- lake |> filter(scenario == labels[["SURF"]], Date >= WIN_START, Date <= WIN_STOP)
    cap <- sum(0.10 * d$surface_area_m2) * MMOL_TO_KG
  }
  cap
}
bud <- lw |> group_by(scenario) |>
  arrange(Date) |>
  summarise(
    uptake_w = sum(uptake_w_kgd), uptake_s = sum(uptake_s_kgd),
    d_alp_w = last(alp_kg) - first(alp_kg),
    d_alp_s = last(ben_alp_kg) - first(ben_alp_kg),
    burial_kbur = sum(K_BUR * ben_alp_kg),
    exported = sum(overflow_m3 * alp_top) * MMOL_TO_KG,
    ala_end = last(ala_kg) + last(ben_ala_kg),
    .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(tag = tags[match(as.character(scenario), labels[tags])]) |>
  rowwise() |> mutate(capacity = cap_by(tag)) |> ungroup() |>
  mutate(removed = uptake_w + uptake_s,
         settled = uptake_w - exported - d_alp_w,
         buried  = settled + uptake_s - d_alp_s,
         kbur_ratio = burial_kbur / buried,
         eff = removed / capacity)

bt <- bud |> filter(scenario != S0) |>
  transmute(Scenario = as.character(scenario),
            `Capacity dosed (t P)` = capacity / 1e3,
            `Uptake: water (t P)` = uptake_w / 1e3,
            `Uptake: benthic (t P)` = uptake_s / 1e3,
            `Total bound (t P)` = removed / 1e3,
            `Efficiency (bound / capacity)` = eff,
            `Exported (t P)` = exported / 1e3,
            `Settled to bed (t P)` = settled / 1e3,
            `Buried (t P)` = buried / 1e3,
            `Pool change: water (t P)` = d_alp_w / 1e3,
            `Pool change: bed (t P)` = d_alp_s / 1e3,
            `k_bur check (ratio)` = kbur_ratio)
kable(bt, digits = 2, caption = "Alum phosphorus budget over the analysis window.")
```


::: {.callout-tip}
Bound P ends up almost entirely in the sediment; the closure-implied burial
and the `k_bur` × stock estimate should agree. A ratio well above 1 would mean
the benthic pool is being drained faster than the closure allows (i.e. the
reported benthic mass is inconsistent with the settling that fed it) and
points at the benthic bookkeeping rather than at the lake result.
:::


```{r}
#| label: fig-budget
#| fig-cap: "Fate of the P bound by alum in S1 (t P over the window)."
fb <- bud |> filter(scenario == S1) |>
  transmute(`Pool change: water` = d_alp_w, `Pool change: bed` = d_alp_s,
            Buried = buried, Exported = exported) |>
  pivot_longer(everything()) |> mutate(value = value / 1e3)
ggplot(fb, aes(reorder(name, -value), value, fill = name)) + geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") + labs(x = NULL, y = "t P")
```


### 5.1 Cumulative removal


```{r}
#| label: fig-cum
#| fig-cap: "Cumulative P bound by alum (S1), with the cumulative P-binding capacity dosed."
il1 <- read_alum_inflow_loads("S1", start = WIN_START, stop = WIN_STOP) |>
  group_by(Date) |> summarise(cap = sum(ala_kgd), .groups = "drop")
cum <- lw |> filter(scenario == S1) |> arrange(Date) |>
  transmute(Date, `water column` = cumsum(uptake_w_kgd) / 1e3,
            `benthic` = cumsum(uptake_s_kgd) / 1e3) |>
  left_join(mutate(il1, `capacity dosed` = cumsum(cap) / 1e3) |> select(Date, `capacity dosed`),
            by = "Date") |>
  mutate(`total bound` = `water column` + benthic) |>
  pivot_longer(-Date)
ggplot(cum, aes(Date, value, colour = name)) + geom_line() +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = NULL) + labs(y = "t P (cumulative)", x = NULL)
```


### 5.2 Effect on the lake's P inventory and export


```{r}
inv <- lw |> group_by(scenario) |>
  summarise(`TP stock, mean (t P)` = mean(tp_kg) / 1e3,
            `FRP stock, mean (t P)` = mean(frp_kg) / 1e3,
            `TP export (t P/yr)` = sum(overflow_m3 * tp_top) * MMOL_TO_KG / 1e3 / N_YR,
            `Potential sediment FRP flux (t P/yr)` = sum(fsed_frp_kgd) / 1e3 / N_YR,
            `Realised internal FRP release (t P/yr)` = sum(dsf_frp_kgd) / 1e3 / N_YR,
            .groups = "drop")
i0 <- inv |> filter(scenario == S0)
kable(inv |> mutate(`dTP stock vs S0 (t P)` = `TP stock, mean (t P)` - i0$`TP stock, mean (t P)`,
                    `dExport vs S0 (t P/yr)` = `TP export (t P/yr)` - i0$`TP export (t P/yr)`),
      digits = 2, caption = "Lake P inventory, outflow export and sediment release by scenario (potential = input flux; realised = after oxygen limitation, see 3.3).")
```


```{r}
#| label: fig-inv
#| fig-cap: "Whole-lake TP stock (t P) in S0 and S1, and the difference."
st <- lake |> filter(scenario %in% c(S0, S1), Date >= WIN_START) |>
  select(Date, scenario, tp_kg) |> mutate(tp_kg = tp_kg / 1e3)
pA <- ggplot(st, aes(Date, tp_kg, colour = scenario)) + geom_line() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal, name = NULL) + labs(y = "TP stock (t P)", x = NULL)
pB <- st |> pivot_wider(names_from = scenario, values_from = tp_kg) |>
  mutate(d = .data[[S1]] - .data[[S0]]) |>
  ggplot(aes(Date, d)) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_line(colour = "#d95f02") + labs(y = "S1 − S0 (t P)", x = NULL)
pA / pB
```


## 6. Sensitivity to dose and floc settling velocity


```{r}
sens <- lw |> group_by(scenario) |>
  summarise(FRP = mean(frp_mean) * 31, TP = mean(tp_mean) * 31, Chl = mean(chl_mean),
            ben_alp_end = last(ben_alp_kg) / 1e3, .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(bud |> select(scenario, removed, eff, uptake_w, uptake_s), by = "scenario") |>
  mutate(`water-col. share` = uptake_w / removed)
s0 <- sens |> filter(scenario == S0)
kable(sens |> transmute(Scenario = scenario,
        `FRP (ug/L)` = FRP, `dFRP %` = 100 * (FRP / s0$FRP - 1),
        `TP (ug/L)` = TP, `dTP %` = 100 * (TP / s0$TP - 1),
        `dChl %` = 100 * (Chl / s0$Chl - 1),
        `Bound P (t)` = removed / 1e3, Efficiency = eff,
        `Water-col. share` = `water-col. share`, `Settled bound P, end (t)` = ben_alp_end),
      digits = 2, caption = "Scenario sensitivity (analysis-window means).")
```


```{r}
#| label: fig-sens
#| fig-cap: "Response to floc settling velocity: change in mean TP and FRP vs S0, alum P removed and its water-column share."
#| fig-height: 6
wl <- sens |> filter(grepl("^w_ala", scenario) | scenario == S1) |>
  mutate(w = ifelse(scenario == S1, 0.5, as.numeric(sub("w_ala ", "", scenario)))) |>
  filter(!duplicated(w)) |>
  mutate(dTP = 100 * (TP / s0$TP - 1), 
         dFRP = 100 * (FRP / s0$FRP - 1),
         removed_adj = removed / 1e3
         ) |> 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(dTP, dFRP, removed_adj, `water-col. share`), 
                      names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    label = dplyr::case_when(
      metric == "dTP" ~ "ΔTP vs S0 (%)",
      metric == "dFRP" ~ "ΔFRP vs S0 (%)",
      metric == "removed_adj" ~ "P bound by alum (t)",
      metric == "water-col. share" ~ "Water-column share of uptake"
    )
  )

p <- ggplot(wl, aes(w, value)) + geom_line() + geom_point() + scale_x_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~label, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  labs(x = "w_ala (m/d)", y = NULL)

p
```


### 6.1 P-binding capacity per Al (jar test vs field)

The thesis gives Al:P = 0.7:1 in the jar test but ~7:1 in the field. This is the
largest unknown in how much of the dosed Al is available to bind lake P, and it acts
like a scale factor on the dosed capacity.

```{r}
#| label: fig-ratio
#| fig-cap: "Change in lake-mean TP relative to S0 (30-day mean) for different P-binding capacity per Al."
#| fig-height: 4.5
rs <- c(S1, "capacity x1.43 (Al:P 0.7:1)", "capacity x0.5", "capacity x0.3",
        "capacity x0.14 (Al:P 7:1)")
rs <- rs[rs %in% levels(lw$scenario)]
dr <- lw |> filter(scenario %in% c(S0, rs)) |>
  select(Date, scenario, tp_mean) |> pivot_wider(names_from = scenario, values_from = tp_mean) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(Date, all_of(S0))) |>
  mutate(d = rm30(value - .data[[S0]]) * 31)
ggplot(dr, aes(Date, d, colour = name)) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_line(linewidth = .4) + scale_colour_viridis_d(name = NULL, option = "C", end = .85) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
  labs(y = "ΔTP vs S0 (ug P/L)", x = NULL)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-ratio-obs
#| fig-cap: "Epilimnion model bias against observations as a function of the capacity scale; S1 = 1."
ratio_tab <- ev |>
  filter(panel %in% c("TP, epilimnion (ug P/L)", "FRP, epilimnion (ug P/L)", "Chl-a, epilimnion (ug/L)"),
         scenario %in% c(S0, rs)) |>
  group_by(panel, scenario) |> summarise(bias = mean(model - obs), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(scale = c(1.43, 0.5, 0.3, 0.143, 1, NA)[match(as.character(scenario),
           c("capacity x1.43 (Al:P 0.7:1)", "capacity x0.5", "capacity x0.3",
             "capacity x0.14 (Al:P 7:1)", S1, S0))]) |> filter(!is.na(scale))
ggplot(ratio_tab, aes(scale, bias)) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_line() + geom_point() + scale_x_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~panel, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  labs(x = "P-binding capacity per Al (relative to 1:1)", y = "Model − observed")
```

### 6.2 Resuspension

The thesis recommends resuspension on (alum is concentrated near-shore, fragile flocs),
but gives no value for `k_res`. The runs below bracket it. Resuspension returns settled
alum to the bottom water, so it should raise bottom-water alum-bound P and lower net burial.

```{r}
#| label: fig-res
#| fig-cap: "Settled alum-bound P (t P, left) and bottom-layer ALU_alp (mmol P/m3, right) for S1 and the resuspension runs."
#| fig-height: 4
rl <- c(S1, "resusp k_res 0.001", "resusp k_res 0.01", "resusp k_res 0.1")
rl <- rl[rl %in% levels(lw$scenario)]
rr <- lw |> filter(scenario %in% rl)
pr1 <- ggplot(rr, aes(Date, ben_alp_kg / 1e3, colour = scenario)) + geom_line(linewidth = .4) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(name = NULL, option = "C", end = .85) + labs(y = "Settled ALU_alp (t P)", x = NULL)
pr2 <- ggplot(rr, aes(Date, alp_bot, colour = scenario)) + geom_line(linewidth = .4) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(name = NULL, option = "C", end = .85) + labs(y = "Bottom ALU_alp (mmol/m3)", x = NULL)
pr1 + pr2 + plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

### 6.3 Surface dose vs inflow dose

Dosing in the stream puts alum into the lake where the stream enters, with the stream
discharge and P load. The surface-dose scenario applies the equivalent mean rate evenly
over the lake, with the stream P load not carrying any alum. Compare the budget rows for
"surface dose" and S1 above.

```{r}
#| label: fig-surf
#| fig-cap: "S1 (inflow dosing) vs a uniform surface dose of the same mean rate: lake-mean FRP and TP."
#| fig-height: 4
sf <- lw |> filter(scenario %in% c(S0, S1, "surface dose 0.1 mmol/m2/d")) |>
  select(Date, scenario, frp_mean, tp_mean) |> pivot_longer(c(frp_mean, tp_mean))
ggplot(sf, aes(Date, value * 31, colour = scenario)) + geom_line(linewidth = .35) +
  facet_wrap(~name, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1,
             labeller = as_labeller(c(frp_mean = "FRP (ug P/L)", tp_mean = "TP (ug P/L)"))) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(name = NULL, option = "C", end = .8) + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
```

## 7. What to check next

* **Burial check** – the `k_bur` ratio in §5 should be ≈ 1; if not, inspect the
  benthic bookkeeping (settling flux is not exported by GLM-AED; add a diagnostic).
* **`w_ala`** – the thesis supports 0.5 m/d (0.3–1.5); the larger floc speeds it
  measured are quiescent upper bounds. Calibrate within about 0.3–1.5 (log scale),
  and only against FRP/TP in dosed years once the baseline FRP/TP bias is understood.
* **Capacity per Al** – the jar-test (0.7:1) and field (~7:1) Al:P ratios span a
  factor of 10 in effective dose; this is likely a more influential unknown than
  `w_ala` and should be a calibration parameter (it scales the dosed `ALU_ala`).
* **Resuspension** – recommended on by the thesis, `k_res` unconstrained.
* **pH efficiency** – the thesis suggests `pH_opt` = 7, `sigma_pH` = 1, but this
  needs `aed_carbon` (for `CAR_pH`), which the lake configuration does not include;
  not tested here.
* **Identifiability** – only lake FRP/TP/chl-a constrain the alum parameters
  (no Al or floc observations), so calibrate at most 3–4 parameters.
* **Natural experiment** – Puarenga was not dosed in WY2020. The S1 − S0 response
  that year is a useful independent check on the dose–response.
